reasons.effort: Claude Code has no live effort setter; changing effort needs a respawn, so it is locked during a turn.

reasons.plan: Plan falls to manual so a spawned child never becomes freer than its plan parent. Grok enters its own plan mode through agent approval, not a stance setter.
reasons.stance: Changing stance needs a respawn, so it is locked during a turn.
reasons.dontAsk: Grok implements dontAsk through yoloMode, the same route as bypassPermissions.

reasons.stance: A stance change needs a respawn. pi has no native permission gate; ordinary picks record bypassPermissions.
reasons.plan: The picker hides plan, but an inherited plan still passes a fixed read-only tool set at spawn.
Plan falls to manual (ask), the narrowest mode fx supports, so inheritance never widens access.
reasons.dontAsk: fx maps dontAsk to auto, not full-access.
reasons.live: fx refuses config changes during a prompt; Carbon holds them for the queued turn.
Codex steers a queued prompt into its running turn and ignores new settings, so all controls are locked.
reasons.plan: The picker hides plan; inherited plan runs with on-request approval and a read-only sandbox.
reasons.dontAsk: The picker hides dontAsk; inherited dontAsk runs with never approval and a workspace-write sandbox.
